# `typescript-operations` config examples

<!-- Generated by tests/config-examples.spec.ts. Do not edit by hand: update the spec and run it with `-u`. -->

Each section has a minimal schema and operation. The TypeScript shows only the declarations the option changes. Lines that differ appear once per setting with a `// option=value` comment.

## `arrayInputCoercion`

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  users(ids: [ID!]): [String!]
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
query Users($ids: [ID!]) {
  users(ids: $ids)
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
export type UsersQueryVariables = Exact<{
  ids?: Array<string | number> | string | number | null | undefined; // arrayInputCoercion=true (default)
  ids?: Array<string | number> | null | undefined; // arrayInputCoercion=false
}>;
```

## `immutableTypes`

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  users(filter: UserFilter): [String!]!
}

input UserFilter {
  names: [String!]
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
query Users($filter: UserFilter) {
  users(filter: $filter)
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
export type UserFilter = {
  names?: Array<string> | null | undefined; // immutableTypes=false (default)
  readonly names?: ReadonlyArray<string> | null | undefined; // immutableTypes=true
};

export type UsersQuery = { users: Array<string> }; // immutableTypes=false (default)
export type UsersQuery = { readonly users: ReadonlyArray<string> }; // immutableTypes=true
```

## `flattenGeneratedTypes`

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  user: User
}

type User {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
fragment UserFields on User {
  name
}

query GetUser {
  user {
    id
    ...UserFields
  }
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
export type UserFieldsFragment = { name: string }; // flattenGeneratedTypes=false (default)
// flattenGeneratedTypes=true: (not generated)
```

## `enumType`

**Schema**

```graphql

  role: Role
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
query GetRole {
  role
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
// enumType='string-literal' (default)
export type Role =
  | 'ADMIN'
  | 'USER';
// enumType='native', enumType='native-with-string-values'
export enum Role {
  Admin = 'ADMIN',
  User = 'USER'
}
// enumType='native-numeric'
export enum Role {
  Admin = 0,
  User = 1
}
// enumType='const'
export const Role = {
  Admin: 'ADMIN',
  User: 'USER'
} as const;
// enumType='native-const'
export const enum Role {
  Admin = 'ADMIN',
  User = 'USER'
};

export type Role = typeof Role[keyof typeof Role]; // enumType='const'
```

## `enumValues`

### Custom values

Shared config: `{ enumType: 'native' }`

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  role: Role
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
query GetRole {
  role
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
export enum Role {
  Admin = 'ADMIN', // enumValues unset (default)
  Admin = 'admin', // enumValues={ Role: { ADMIN: 'admin', USER: 'user' } }
  User = 'USER' // enumValues unset (default)
  User = 'user' // enumValues={ Role: { ADMIN: 'admin', USER: 'user' } }
}
```

### External enum

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  role: Role
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
query GetRole {
  role
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
import { MyRole as Role } from './my-enums'; // enumValues={ Role: './my-enums#MyRole' }

// enumValues unset (default)
export type Role =
  | 'ADMIN'
  | 'USER';
export { Role }; // enumValues={ Role: './my-enums#MyRole' }
```

### Import all enums from a file

> Only the plain-string form `enumValues: './my-enums'` imports from the file. A per-enum path without `#` (`enumValues: { Role: './my-enums' }`) changes nothing.

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  role: Role
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
query GetRole {
  role
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
import { Role } from './my-enums'; // enumValues='./my-enums'

// enumValues unset (default), enumValues={ Role: './my-enums' }
export type Role =
  | 'ADMIN'
  | 'USER';
export { Role }; // enumValues='./my-enums'
```

```graphql
  USER

}
```

```ts
export enum Role {
  Admin = 'admin-internal', // ignoreEnumValuesFromSchema=false (default)
  Admin = 'ADMIN', // ignoreEnumValuesFromSchema=true
  User = 'user-internal' // ignoreEnumValuesFromSchema=false (default)
  User = 'USER' // ignoreEnumValuesFromSchema=true
}
```

```ts
export type UserFilter = {
  name?: string | null | undefined; // avoidOptionals=false (default), avoidOptionals={ variableValue: true }, avoidOptionals={ defaultValue: true }

  active?: boolean | null | undefined; // avoidOptionals=false (default), avoidOptionals={ variableValue: true }, avoidOptionals={ defaultValue: true }
  active: boolean | null | undefined; // avoidOptionals=true, avoidOptionals={ inputValue: true }
};

export type UsersQueryVariables = Exact<{
  filter?: UserFilter | null | undefined; // avoidOptionals=false (default), avoidOptionals={ inputValue: true }, avoidOptionals={ defaultValue: true }

}>;
```

**Operation**

```graphql
}
```


## `useTypeImports`

> The import of the `importSchemaTypesFrom` file is always `import type`. This option affects imports of external enums and scalars.

Shared config: `{ enumValues: { Role: './my-enums#MyRole' } }`

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  role: Role
}

  ADMIN
  USER
}
```

```graphql

  role
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
import { MyRole as Role } from './my-enums'; // useTypeImports=false (default)
import type { MyRole as Role } from './my-enums'; // useTypeImports=true
```

## `inlineFragmentTypes`

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  user: User
}

type User {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
fragment UserFields on User {
  name
}

query GetUser {
  user {
    id
    ...UserFields
  }
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
export type UserFieldsFragment = { name: string }; // inlineFragmentTypes='inline' (default), inlineFragmentTypes='combine'
export type UserFieldsFragment = { name: string } & { ' $fragmentName'?: 'UserFieldsFragment' }; // inlineFragmentTypes='mask'

export type GetUserQuery = { user: { id: string, name: string } | null }; // inlineFragmentTypes='inline' (default)
// inlineFragmentTypes='combine'
export type GetUserQuery = { user: (
    { id: string }
    & UserFieldsFragment
  ) | null };
// inlineFragmentTypes='mask'
export type GetUserQuery = { user: (
    { id: string }
    & { ' $fragmentRefs'?: { 'UserFieldsFragment': UserFieldsFragment } }
  ) | null };
```

## `includeExternalFragments`

> This option has no effect in `typescript-operations`: external fragments passed via `externalFragments` are resolved into the operation types whether it is set or not. Both runs pass the fragment below via `externalFragments`.

```graphql
fragment ExternalUserFields on User {
    name
  }
```

**Schema**

```graphql
type Query {
  user: User
}

type User {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
}
```

**Operation**

```graphql
query GetUser {
  user {
    id
    ...ExternalUserFields
  }
}
```

**Generated TypeScript**

```ts
// Output is identical for every setting:

export type GetUserQueryVariables = Exact<{ [key: string]: never; }>;

export type GetUserQuery = { user: { id: string, name: string } | null };
```
